company.name: Ascen
company.description: Ascen is a modern Employer of Record built specifically for staffing firms and platforms, helping agencies scale rapidly and compliantly across the US, UK, Canada, and 140+ countries worldwide. Through an all-in-one, white-label platform, Ascen combines EOR, payroll, funding, compliance, insurance, and back-office support with API and ATS integrations, so staffing businesses can onboard contractors faster, expand into new markets, reduce operational complexity, and support more clients and talent without building additional infrastructure.

productsAndServices.description: Ascen acts as the legal employer of record for staffing firms' candidates, managing onboarding, payroll, benefits, and workers' compensation insurance across multiple regions.
productsAndServices.name: Employer of Record (EOR) for Staffing

productsAndServices.description: Ascen partners with staffing agencies to act as Agent of Record for independent contractors, ensuring correct classification and managing onboarding, payments, compliance, and invoicing.
productsAndServices.name: Agent of Record (AOR) for Independent Contractor Compliance

productsAndServices.description: A comprehensive pay and bill platform tailored for staffing organizations to manage onboarding, timesheets, payroll, invoicing, and reporting under their own brand.
productsAndServices.name: White Label Pay and Bill Software

productsAndServices.description: A mobile-friendly worker portal for managing contractor onboarding requirements including I-9, W-4, background checks, drug tests, credentialing, and benefits.
productsAndServices.name: Onboarding and Screening Portal

productsAndServices.description: An integrated payroll funding service that provides capital to staffing firms to pay contractors timely before client invoice payments are received.
productsAndServices.name: Payroll Funding Solution

productsAndServices.description: A white-label timesheet and expense approval system with candidate and client portals, automated reminders, and integration with payroll and billing.
productsAndServices.name: Timesheet and Expense Management Module

insights.title: Valuation increased across disclosed rounds
insights.statement: Known post-money valuation rose from $4,140,702 to $4,140,702, a 1x increase.
insights.implication: The disclosed financing history indicates a material valuation step-up between the earliest and latest rounds with known valuations.
caveats: Only rounds with a disclosed post-money valuation are compared.

insights.title: Sharp recent attention and growth momentum
insights.statement: Crunchbase scores growth at 80 (-3 over 90 days) and market heat at 46 (-5).
insights.implication: The company has recently become much more visible, but the scores should be treated as attention/activity indicators rather than revenue or clinical-performance metrics.
caveats: Crunchbase does not expose the complete weighting behind these proprietary scores.

insights.implication: These matches provide a starting point for comparing differentiation, scale, and shared specialties, but they should not be treated as a verified competitor set.
